quests.dispatcherQuestion: A customer is choking in a restaurant and cannot speak. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Stress both the team needed and the urgency.
quests.explanation: A blocked airway is a true emergency, so trained medical help must be sent without delay.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Grease has caught fire on a stovetop in a diner kitchen. Input fire code!
quests.hint: Name the service that puts out fires.
quests.explanation: Grease fires can flare up suddenly, so trained firefighters should be the ones to put it out.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A man is seen spray-painting graffiti on a shop's front wall. Input police code!
quests.hint: Name the service that responds to crime.
quests.explanation: A patrol car nearby can respond fast enough to catch the person before they leave.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A girl has fallen from a swing and her arm looks bent oddly. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Name the vehicle that carries paramedics.
quests.explanation: A bent arm may be a fracture, so paramedics should check and support it before she is moved.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Sparks from a firework have landed on a dry hedge. Input fire code!
quests.hint: Name the vehicle firefighters arrive in.
quests.explanation: Dry hedges catch fire fast, so a crew should put it out before it reaches nearby homes.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A woman says a stranger is trying to open her front door at night. Input police code!
quests.hint: Ask for a police vehicle already on the road.
quests.explanation: Someone trying to enter a home at night needs a fast police response to keep her safe.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A worker has cut his hand badly on a box cutter. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Ask for help urgently, using the word 'now'.
quests.explanation: A bad cut can bleed a lot, so trained help should arrive quickly to treat it properly.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A cigarette left burning has set a sofa cushion alight. Input fire code!
quests.hint: Ask for the team that puts out fires.
quests.explanation: Sofa fires produce thick smoke fast, so the fire brigade should be called right away.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A man is seen taking a bicycle that is not his. Input police code!
quests.hint: Let the police know what you're seeing.
quests.explanation: Reporting a theft as it happens gives police the best chance to find the bicycle and the thief.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A jogger has collapsed in the park and is breathing strangely. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Ask plainly for someone trained to treat them.
quests.explanation: Strange breathing after collapsing could mean a serious problem, so an ambulance should be sent at once.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A barbecue has flared up and caught the garden fence alight. Input fire code!
quests.hint: Let the local fire team know right away.
quests.explanation: A fence fire can spread between houses quickly, so a properly equipped crew should respond.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A man is seen trying car door handles along a quiet street. Input police code!
quests.hint: Send the service that handles this kind of incident.
quests.explanation: Someone checking for unlocked cars may be planning a theft, so police should be called right away.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A diabetic man is shaking and confused after missing a meal. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Ask for the medical team by name.
quests.explanation: Shaking and confusion can signal dangerously low blood sugar, which paramedics can treat quickly.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Wiring behind a television has started smoking. Input fire code!
quests.hint: Name the department responsible for fire risks.
quests.explanation: Electrical smoke can turn into a fire fast, so the fire station should be told immediately.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A woman reports her car window smashed and her bag stolen. Input police code!
quests.hint: Send an official police vehicle to the scene.
quests.explanation: A dispatched unit can record the damage and begin looking for the stolen bag nearby.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A cyclist has been knocked off his bike by a car door. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Ask for the medical team, and add urgency.
quests.explanation: A road impact like this can cause hidden injuries that only trained paramedics should assess.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A pan of hot oil has caught fire on a stove. Input fire code!
quests.hint: Ask for the vehicles firefighters arrive in, urgently.
quests.explanation: Oil fires need a trained crew, since water alone can make this type of fire worse.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Two men are arguing loudly and one has pushed the other. Input police code!
quests.hint: Ask for the police, and stress the urgency.
quests.explanation: A patrol car can arrive quickly to calm the situation before it turns into a real fight.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A baby has a very high fever and won't stop crying. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Ask plainly for trained help to be sent.
quests.explanation: A very high fever in a baby needs a paramedic's assessment as soon as possible.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A neighbor's chimney is throwing sparks onto a thatched roof. Input fire code!
quests.hint: Send the official service trained to fight fires.
quests.explanation: Thatched roofs catch fire extremely fast, so firefighters need to respond without delay.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A man is seen following a woman closely and she looks frightened. Input police code!
quests.hint: Ask for police, and stress the urgency.
quests.explanation: A quick police response can check on her safety before the situation gets worse.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A teenager has twisted his ankle badly during football practice. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Formally ask for the ambulance to be sent.
quests.explanation: A badly twisted ankle should be checked by trained staff in case a bone is broken.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A microwave has started sparking and smoking inside a break room. Input fire code!
quests.hint: Say who's needed, and stress the urgency.
quests.explanation: Electrical appliance fires can restart after they appear to go out, so a crew should check it fully.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A store's alarm is sounding and a man is running out with bags. Input police code!
quests.hint: Say who's needed, and where.
quests.explanation: An alarm plus someone running out is a clear sign of a theft in progress.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A man has a deep nosebleed that will not stop after ten minutes. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Ask for the vehicle that carries paramedics to come.
quests.explanation: A nosebleed that won't stop after this long needs proper medical assessment, not just first aid.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A generator has caught fire behind an apartment building. Input fire code!
quests.hint: Name who should respond, and add urgency.
quests.explanation: Fuel-powered generators can explode when they catch fire, so a trained crew must handle it.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A parked car has been broken into and the radio is missing. Input police code!
quests.hint: Ask for the extra support officers need.
quests.explanation: Reporting the theft right away lets police note details while the trail is still fresh.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A woman has stepped on a rusty nail and it went through her shoe. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Send help trained to treat injuries.
quests.explanation: Puncture wounds from rusty metal carry an infection risk that trained medical staff should assess.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: An overloaded extension cord has started to melt and smoke. Input fire code!
quests.hint: Name the service that puts out fires.
quests.explanation: A melting cord can ignite at any moment, so the fire station should be alerted immediately.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A group of teenagers is throwing rocks at passing cars from a bridge. Input police code!
quests.hint: Name the service that responds to crime.
quests.explanation: This is dangerous to drivers below, so a unit should be sent before someone is badly hurt.
